lab.title: Three airlines, public fare signals first.
lab.intro: Look up recently cached fares from the public pages of China Airlines, EVA Air and STARLUX. Use this to get a sense of direction: it is not live inventory and you cannot book from here.
lab.safeBody: Official domains only, robots rules respected and requests rate-limited. We never sign in to an airline account or touch private booking inventory.
lab.returnBeforeDeparture: The return date cannot be before the departure date.
lab.chargeHelp: Requires a Mokaair sign-in. Charged ({charge}) only when public fares come back; nothing is charged if the search fails.
lab.errorTitle: The search could not be completed
lab.emptyTitle: Set the route you want to see first
lab.emptyBody: Results keep the airline, dates, public price, when the source was updated and the original page. Flight numbers and live inventory are never made up.
lab.busy: Checking each source's policy and fare page…
lab.notCharged: No usable fares found, so this search was not charged
lab.noQuotes: No cached public fares around the chosen dates.
lab.notLive: Not live · cannot be booked here
b2b.summaryMissing: Missing a complete fare or exchange rate
b2b.conventionalSaves: Buying regular tickets is estimated to save {amount}
b2b.samePrice: Both ways of buying are estimated at the same price
b2b.cannotCompare: The prices cannot be compared right now
b2b.reverseTickets: Two-segment ticket from abroad + opening and closing one-ways
b2b.nestedTickets: Wrapper ticket + reverse ticket from abroad
b2b.datesOutOfOrder: Dates must run in order: first departure, first return, second departure, second return.
b2b.strategyHint.reverse_two_segment: Reverse round trip + two one-ways at the ends
b2b.strategyHint.nested_round_trips: Round trip from Taiwan + round trip from abroad
b2b.reverseLegend: Complete the two-segment ticket from abroad
b2b.reverseHelp: Enter the one-way prices per traveller that you actually found for the opening and closing flights. If both trips go to the same destination you can leave the middle empty and the public reverse round-trip fare is compared instead; if the destinations differ, the middle is a multi-city ticket "first destination → Taiwan → second destination" that you need to enter yourself. Every manual value is clearly labelled and never derived by splitting a round-trip fare.
b2b.middleOptional: Middle: reverse round trip from abroad (optional)
b2b.fare.head: Opening one-way
b2b.manualLegend: Fill in when no public regular fare is found
b2b.manualHelp: Both fields are optional. If the airlines' public cache has no regular round-trip price near your dates, enter the total per person you found with the airline or a travel agency so the comparison can still finish.
b2b.starluxTitle: STARLUX alone may not give a complete back-to-back set
b2b.starluxBody: STARLUX's public pages list scattered dates, and every fare needed has to fall within the flexible dates before it can be compared. The search still runs and shows the nearest public dates; to check the full flow first, select China Airlines as well.
b2b.chargeHelp: Charged ({charge}) only when at least one comparable set of prices comes back; nothing is charged if it fails.
b2b.emptyTitle: A fair comparison needs two trips
b2b.emptyBody: Compare "two-segment ticket from abroad + opening and closing one-ways" and "wrapper ticket + reverse ticket from abroad" separately, instead of treating both as the same kind of back-to-back.
b2b.busy: Reading public fares from Taiwan and from abroad…
b2b.notCharged: No comparable prices found, so this search was not charged
b2b.differentDestinationsTitle: Two-segment tickets from abroad now work with different destinations
b2b.differentDestinationsBody: The middle shows "first destination → Taiwan" and then "Taiwan → second destination". The public cache has no total for this kind of multi-city ticket, so the comparison uses the middle fare you entered, marked as manual.
b2b.openJawTitle: With two different destinations, back-to-back tickets become open-jaw tickets
b2b.openJawBody: For now only the baseline price of two round trips from Taiwan can be verified. A full back-to-back plan needs a multi-city fare source for "Taiwan → first destination, second destination → Taiwan" and the reverse; until one is connected, no price is estimated.
b2b.rawTitle: Fares found, in their original currency
b2b.fxNote: TWD estimates use {source} rates for {rates}; the amount actually charged to your card may differ.
b2b.disclaimerBody: Every ticket has to be flown in full, in the order of its coupons. The opening and closing one-ways and the reverse ticket of a two-segment plan are managed separately; public prices are not live inventory and cannot be booked here, and changes and cancellations are handled ticket by ticket.
live.incomplete: Required fares are missing, so no plan is built.
live.datesOutOfOrder: Dates must run in order: first departure, first return, second departure, second return.
live.title: Live back-to-back price comparison
live.intro: Searches two regular round trips and the opening, middle and closing back-to-back tickets in one go; nothing is estimated when a ticket is missing.
live.empty: Set up two trips to start searching.
live.backToBackTitle: Opening + two segments from abroad + closing
warning.fare_source_paused: {airline}: reading its official fare pages is paused under the fail-closed policy.
warning.fare_route_unsupported: {airline}: the public fare pages do not cover this route yet.
warning.fare_page_blocked: {airline} {page}: the source's policy does not allow reading this fare page.
warning.fare_page_unavailable: {airline} {page}: the fare page cannot be read right now.
warning.fare_not_cached: {airline}: {role} — no cached public fare within {flex_days} days of the chosen dates
warning.fare_not_cached_nearest: {airline}: {role} — no cached public fare within {flex_days} days of the chosen dates; the nearest on the public page is {nearest}
warning.stale_exchange_rate: {currency}: the TWD estimate uses an older exchange rate from the past seven days.
warning.exchange_rate_unavailable: {currency}: no exchange rate is available for a TWD estimate right now.
warning.open_jaw_baseline_only: The two destinations differ: a full back-to-back comparison needs an open-jaw fare source, so only the verifiable regular-ticket baseline is shown.
warning.fare_public_ready: {airline}: public recent fares; robots.txt is checked again when the cache expires.
warning.fare_public_empty: {airline}: the source is available, but no cached public fares match the dates or cabin.
warning.fare_public_blocked: {airline}: the source's policy does not allow reading these public fares.
warning.fare_public_unavailable: {airline}: the public fare page cannot be read right now.
warning.fare_browser_loaded: {airline}: the browser capture was normalized by the public fare parser.
warning.fare_browser_empty: {airline}: the browser capture succeeded, but no cached public fares match the dates or cabin.
warning.fare_both_directions_loaded: Public recent fares from Taiwan and from abroad loaded successfully.
warning.fare_two_trips_loaded: Public recent fares from Taiwan for both trips loaded successfully.
warning.fare_directions_partial: Public recent fares were obtained for only some directions.
warning.fare_both_directions_unavailable: Public fares from Taiwan and from abroad could not be obtained.
warning.fare_two_trips_unavailable: Public fares from Taiwan for either trip could not be obtained.
warning.fare_comparison_unavailable: {mode}: complete fares or exchange rates are missing, so no comparison is available.
warning.fare_comparison_regular_cheaper: {mode}: regular tickets are estimated to cost less.
warning.fare_comparison_equal: {mode}: both ways of buying have the same estimated total.
warning.fare_comparison_missing: {mode}: missing {roles}, so a complete comparison cannot be built. This is not 0% savings.
warning.fare_comparison_incompatible: {mode}: candidate fares exist, but their dates, airlines or exchange rates cannot form a compatible complete plan.
warning.fare_comparison_open_jaw: {mode}: two regular round trips have been priced. Different destinations require two open-jaw tickets for back-to-back travel; public fare pages lack those prices, so no back-to-back total is estimated.
warning.live_comparison_complete: All required fares come from the same live comparison actively requested by the user.
warning.live_comparison_missing: {roles}: required fares are missing, so no incomplete plan is built.
warning.live_comparison_incomplete: Candidate fares cannot form a compatible complete plan; no incomplete comparison is built.
